MediaSource.title: MediaSource
MediaSource.description: A user-saved channel, M3U playlist, website, or direct movie stream source.

userId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the owning user.

title.description: Display name of the channel, website, or playlist.

url.description: Stream URL, M3U playlist URL, or website URL.

category.description: Category label such as Movies, Live TV, Animation, or Web.

logoUrl.description: Optional poster or channel logo URL.

channelCount.description: Number of channels discovered in an M3U playlist (0 for single sources).

LibraryItem.title: LibraryItem
LibraryItem.description: A user's favorited movie/channel or watch history entry with resume position.

userId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the owning user.

streamUrl.description: Playable video or HLS stream URL.

favorite.description: Whether the user bookmarked this item in their watchlist.

durationMs.description: Total duration in milliseconds (0 for live streams).

lastWatchedAt.description: Optional server timestamp of last playback (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

/users/{userId}/sources/{sourceId}.description: User-saved channels, M3U playlists, and movie websites.

/users/{userId}/library/{itemId}.description: User's favorite movies, bookmarks, and playback resume history.
